name: Taeko-sensei
source:
Self-proclaimed foxy Nightingale (objectively she [i]is[/i] a babe), Taeko-sensei's gentle, intelligent gaze watching over her students makes her...almost makes her look like the ideal school nurse. Even with her lab coat on you can tell she's rockin' a killer bod, and of course once that coat comes off, Q.E.D. 

Liked foods: durian, herbal tea, the rest are secret 
Disliked foods: secret
